subject: Evidence pack review — customer data status & sample hashes
messages:
From: Ian Meyers <ian.m@rezco-payments.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@rezco-payments.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short evidence summary & confirmation of no customer record exposure

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the post-incident update you shared earlier. We have an upcoming internal audit and the compliance team has asked for a short evidence summary that confirms whether any ReZco customer records were read, exported, or otherwise exposed during the 10/01 incident.

Can you provide: 1) a one-paragraph statement for our auditors, 2) a sampling of the access logs (redacted as needed) and 3) cryptographic hashes for any artifacts you provide so we can verify integrity on our side. A secure link or attachments are fine.

We're on a tight deadline for the audit (EOD Monday), so any expedited help is appreciated.

— Ian
VP Ops, ReZco Payments
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Ian Meyers <ian.m@rezco-payments.com>
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short evidence summary & confirmation of no customer record exposure

Ian —

Thanks for the request and the deadline note. We're putting a short evidence pack together now. Quick summary up-front: our initial investigation (full chain-of-custody below) shows no read or export operations targeting ReZco customer records during the incident window. We will include sampled access logs, an artifacts manifest, and SHA-256 hashes for every file in the pack so you can verify integrity.

Plan & deliverables:
- Forensic evidence manifest (CSV) listing artifacts and timestamps
- Redacted access log sample keyed to the incident window (UTC 2026-10-01T02:12:00 - 2026-10-01T03:05:00)
- SHA-256 hashes for each artifact
- A concise auditor-facing statement you can paste into the audit record

We'll deliver the pack via a secure Drive link with view-only access and include the hashes in a separate text file. Marcus will attach the sampled logs and Rachel will draft the auditor statement. ETA: Monday 2026-10-04 by 17:00 PDT.

If you need the auditor statement earlier, tell us which format your team prefers (PDF vs plain text).

— Lauren
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short evidence summary & confirmation of no customer record exposure

Team —

Attached are the sampled artifacts and hashes (see attachment stubs below). I pulled the logs from the eventstore for the incident window and applied the same redaction rules we use for customer-facing packs (no PII, request IDs only where permitted). Quick verification notes:
- Access-log-sample.txt: shows only system-level retries and internal health checks; no requests matched ReZco customer IDs or api_key patterns tied to ReZco.
- evidence_manifest.csv: maps artifact filenames to UTC timestamps and collection host.
- sha256-hashes.txt: SHA-256 values for each artifact in the pack.

Chain-of-custody: collected by marcus_lin on 2026-10-03, transferred to secure bucket, checksummed and packaged 2026-10-04. Full audit trail will be included in the final forensic bucket.

Attachment stubs:
- evidence_manifest.csv (CSV, 12 rows)
- access-log-sample.txt (TXT, ~2.3kB)
- sha256-hashes.txt (TXT, 4 lines)
- forensic-readme.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

I am confident these samples support the conclusion: no customer record reads or exports for ReZco during the incident window.

— Marcus
Forensics Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ian Meyers <ian.m@rezco-payments.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@rezco-payments.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short evidence summary & confirmation of no customer record exposure

Lauren / Marcus —

Received the pack and the hashes — thanks for the thoroughness and the quick turnaround. ReZco compliance ran the SHA-256 checks and everything matched. The auditor statement worked well for our documentation; they asked one clarifying question about retention windows which we resolved (we confirmed retention config unchanged).

Appreciate the chain-of-custody notes. Please mark this thread as closed from our side — I'll reach out if the auditor requests anything additional.

— Ian
VP Ops, ReZco Payments
